snippet.title: Restless Rites: Demo - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Restless Rites: Demo is out now! 🔥

Enter a forgotten chapel in a quiet town... and become its last caretaker. ⛪ 

In this surreal horror experience, you’ll maintain a cursed sanctuary, improvise with limited tools, and complete your daily tasks before nightfall. 🌒 Because when the light fades, the decay begins to breathe... 🕯️ 

Will you keep the curse under control, or will you become part of it? 👁️

Play Restless Rites: Demo now! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4048840/Restless_Rites_Demo
